name: haishoku-sanzo-wada-color-combinations
title: Haishoku: Sanzo Wada Color Combinations
description: 348 verified color combinations and 159 named colors from Sanzo Wada's Haishoku Soukan (1933-34), as printed in Seigensha's A Dictionary of Color Combinations (2010).

sources.title: A Dictionary of Color Combinations, Seigensha 2010, ISBN 978-4-86152-247-5

resources.name: colors
resources.description: 159 named colors: printed CMYK, three hex readings, RGB, CIELAB/LCh, HSL, hue family and usage counts. One row per color.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Color number 1–159, in the order of the book's reference swatches. Primary key.

fields.name: name
fields.description: English name as printed (historical spellings kept, e.g. *Cerulian Blue*). Unique.

fields.name: base
fields.description: `name` without the `(variant a/b)` suffix. Only Eugenia Red and Grayish Lavender have variants.

fields.name: c
fields.description: Printed process-ink percentages, 0–100.

fields.name: m
fields.description: Printed process-ink percentages, 0–100.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Printed process-ink percentages, 0–100.

fields.name: k
fields.description: Printed process-ink percentages, 0–100.

fields.name: hex_cmyk
fields.description: Naive CMYK→RGB conversion. It runs more saturated than the book.

fields.name: scan_hex
fields.description: Raw scanned color of the reference swatch, which has a blue-gray paper cast.

fields.name: display_hex
fields.description: **Recommended screen color.** The reference swatch, white-balanced so the paper reads as white.

fields.name: display_r
fields.description: sRGB channels of `display_hex`, 0–255.

fields.name: display_g
fields.description: sRGB channels of `display_hex`, 0–255.

fields.name: display_b
fields.description: sRGB channels of `display_hex`, 0–255.

fields.name: scan_r
fields.description: sRGB channels of `scan_hex`, 0–255.

fields.name: scan_g
fields.description: sRGB channels of `scan_hex`, 0–255.

fields.name: scan_b
fields.description: sRGB channels of `scan_hex`, 0–255.

fields.name: lab_l
fields.description: CIELAB (D65) of `display_hex`.

fields.name: lab_a
fields.description: CIELAB (D65) of `display_hex`.

fields.name: lab_b
fields.description: CIELAB (D65) of `display_hex`.

fields.name: lch_c
fields.description: CIE LCh chroma and hue angle (degrees) of `display_hex`.

fields.name: lch_h
fields.description: CIE LCh chroma and hue angle (degrees) of `display_hex`.

fields.name: hsl_h
fields.description: HSL hue in degrees, with saturation and lightness in %, of `display_hex`.

fields.name: hsl_s
fields.description: HSL hue in degrees, with saturation and lightness in %, of `display_hex`.

fields.name: hsl_l
fields.description: HSL hue in degrees, with saturation and lightness in %, of `display_hex`.

fields.name: hue_family
fields.description: A rule-based family label (red, pink, orange, brown, yellow, olive, green, cyan, blue, violet, magenta, gray, black, white). It is derived from HSL, so treat it as a convenience label, not an authority.

fields.name: is_variant
fields.description: True for the four variant colors (ids 12, 13, 134, 135).

fields.name: ref_page
fields.description: Page of the reference swatch in the scanned edition (285–351).

fields.name: combo_count
fields.description: Number of combinations that use this color.

fields.name: combo_count_2
fields.description: The same count, split by combination size.

fields.name: combo_count_3
fields.description: The same count, split by combination size.

fields.name: combo_count_4
fields.description: The same count, split by combination size.

fields.name: appears_in
fields.description: Space-separated, zero-padded combination numbers.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Empty except for id 19, Etruscan Red, whose K value was corrected from 0 to 6 to match its swatch page.

resources.name: combinations
resources.description: 348 combinations (2, 3 or 4 colors), with book page, layout, color ids, names and display hexes. One row per combination.

fields.name: number
fields.description: Combination number 1–348, in book order. Primary key.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Number of colors: 2 (numbers 1–120), 3 (121–240) or 4 (241–348).

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page in the scanned edition.

fields.name: positions
fields.description: Layout on the plate: `left/right`, `left/middle/right`, or `top/left/right/bottom` for the four-color cross.

fields.name: color_ids
fields.description: Space-separated color ids in book order.

fields.name: color_names
fields.description: Color names in book order, separated by ` \| `.

fields.name: display_hexes
fields.description: Space-separated `display_hex` values in book order.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: `verified-visual` for every row.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Back-index cross-check, e.g. `back-index (OCR) confirms 3/4`, plus a note on which variant was picked where one applies.

resources.name: combination_colors
resources.description: Long-format join table, one row per color slot (1,032), linking combinations to colors with per-swatch measurements.

fields.name: combination_number
fields.description: Foreign key → `combinations.number`.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: 1-based position in book order. Together with `combination_number`, this forms the primary key.

fields.name: position
fields.description: `left`, `middle`, `right`, `top` or `bottom`.

fields.name: color_id
fields.description: Foreign key → `colors.id`.

fields.name: color_name
fields.description: Copy of `colors.name`, kept for convenience.

fields.name: display_hex
fields.description: Copy of `colors.display_hex`.

fields.name: page_sample_hex
fields.description: Color sampled from this swatch on the combination page, before matching.

fields.name: label_ocr_match
fields.description: 0–1 string similarity between the OCR of the printed label and `color_name`.

fields.name: delta_e
fields.description: CIEDE2000 distance between the page sample and the matched reference swatch (0.3–10.1).

resources.name: combinations-wide
resources.description: Wide layout identical to data/combinations.csv in the GitHub repo (zero-padded number, up to 4 slot columns).

resources.name: wada-colors-and-combinations
resources.description: Canonical nested JSON (meta, colors, combinations with per-slot page sample, OCR score and delta E).
